prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1036; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on tape, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, close to a shopping center. I was moving over one lane to get to a turn.
Q: What were you doing right before the contact?
A: I checked my mirror, saw what I thought was clear space, and signaled. As I started to move over, I felt a bump on my side and heard scraping metal.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not really. It came up on my blind spot. I didn't see it until the sound happened.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: Maybe the speed of traffic, somewhere around the posted limit. Traffic was moving steadily.
Q: Did you stop after the collision?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder and turned on my hazards.
Q: Were you injured?
A: I hit my head on the window frame. I've been diagnosed with a concussion. I've had headaches, sensitivity to light, and I'm having trouble concentrating at work.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I'm seeing a doctor and I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as possible.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want my vehicle repaired and my medical bills taken care of. I'm willing to provide my medical records.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
